description.value:
You're in a toxic atmosphere, full of gases that are poisonous to most creatures.

Breathing it usually deals 1d6 to 2d6 poison (@Damage[(@item.badge.value)d6[poison]]) damage each minute.

Basic environmental protection doesn't filter these gases. You need an upgrade such as a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.0kD0MZgiK0SYS6e6]{Filtered Rebreather}, or a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-enhanced-environmental-protection.upgrades.Item.9v9qhSuJ1ZFyHAeH]{Filtered Air Supply} under the Enhanced Rules.
